title: bug: moe-call.sh falls back past a vanished MOE_PROXY_PATH under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1
description: scripts/moe-call.sh resolves its proxy at lines 144-166: MOE_PROXY_PATH if -f, else the repo proxy, else the global install. It ignores MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED. CQ-R13c2 guards the two moe-agent.sh calls (the EXIT-trap and hot-reload deregister) with `moe_call_allowed` ([ -f "$PROXY_PATH_OVERRIDE" ]). If the file vanishes between that check and moe-call.sh:145, the deregister runs a non-protected proxy. Fix in moe-call.sh: when MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED is exactly 1, use only MOE_PROXY_PATH, and fail without falling back.
definitionOfDone: With MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 and MOE_PROXY_PATH missing or not a file, moe-call.sh exits non-zero and runs no repo or global proxy. Shown by a harness test with decoys.
Without the marker, or with any other value, moe-call.sh's resolution order is unchanged.

implementationPlan.description:
GREEN: in scripts/moe-call.sh, replace the single line `PROXY_PATH=$(find_proxy)` (line 187) with a protected branch. Keep find_proxy and every other line byte-unchanged, so DoD 2 holds by construction:

    if [ "${MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED:-}" = 1 ]; then
        case "${MOE_PROXY_PATH:-}" in
            /*|[A-Za-z]:[\\/]*) PROXY_PATH="$MOE_PROXY_PATH" ;;
            *) PROXY_PATH="" ;;
        esac
        if [ -z "$PROXY_PATH" ] || [ ! -f "$PROXY_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Error: MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED_PATH_MISSING: MOE_PROXY_PATH must be an absolute path to an existing file when MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1; refusing to start." >&2
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        PROXY_PATH=$(find_proxy)
    fi

Above it, add a 3-line comment covering: CQ-R13c2; the marker counts only when it is exactly '1' and is inherited by every caller; only MOE_PROXY_PATH runs, with no fallback; the refusal names the variable, never its value.

Error handling, fail closed:
- A missing, empty, relative or non-regular MOE_PROXY_PATH under the marker prints the one refusal line on stderr and exits 1 before any proxy, request or daemon contact.
- A file that vanishes after the check makes node fail to load it, and the helper exits 1 through its existing 'no response from daemon' path. No fallback runs there either.
- Every legacy error path (python, node, proxy not found, daemon not running, bad JSON) is unchanged.

Why this shape:
(a) The exit is top-level. An exit inside find_proxy only leaves the $(…) subshell, and find_proxy's step 1 accepts relative paths.
(b) Both case arms assign PROXY_PATH, so an inherited PROXY_PATH environment variable can never survive into the protected branch. The `inherited` decoy row kills that mutant.
(c) Use `if … ||`, not `[ -f ] && …` inside the case, so set -e stays plain on macOS CI's /bin/bash 3.2.
(d) Same absolute pattern and the same sentence as moe-agent.sh's require_protected_runtime_file and refuse_unprotected_runtime (R13c2, lines 716-725), behind this helper's existing 'Error: ' prefix. This is the governor's contract.

Live-runtime save: every seat runs this file from this checkout (the EXIT-trap and hot-reload deregister), and bash reads a script incrementally, so never rewrite it in place:
1. `cp -p scripts/moe-call.sh scripts/.moe-call.sh.new`.
2. Edit the .new copy.
3. `bash -n scripts/.moe-call.sh.new`.
4. One `mv -f scripts/.moe-call.sh.new scripts/moe-call.sh`.
5. `bash -n scripts/moe-call.sh`.
Keep LF endings (.gitattributes: *.sh eol=lf) and mode 100755. Report only scripts/moe-call.sh in modifiedFiles. No build, clean or install anywhere in the shared checkout (GLOBAL rail).

comments.author: qa-12f7cf2d
comments.content: QA note from the CQ-R13c2 review (qa-12f7cf2d): there is one more moe-call.sh route this fix should cover. With MOE_FALLBACK_CLI=1, moe-agent.sh (~line 7746) tells the agent itself to run `bash scripts/moe-call.sh <tool> ...`. Those agent-run calls skip moe_call_allowed entirely and use moe-call.sh's own fallback chain if MOE_PROXY_PATH has vanished. Making moe-call.sh honor MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 (exact MOE_PROXY_PATH or fail) closes this route too. Please add a row for it beside the deregister rows.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: With MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED exactly '1', scripts/moe-call.sh uses only MOE_PROXY_PATH, which must be an absolute path (/…, X:/… or X:\…) to a regular file. Otherwise it prints one stderr line and exits 1 before any proxy runs, never naming the value. The line is: 'Error: MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED_PATH_MISSING: MOE_PROXY_PATH must be an absolute path to an existing file when MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1; refusing to start.' With any other marker value, or none, the unchanged find_proxy order runs: MOE_PROXY_PATH if -f, then the repo dist proxy, then the ~/.moe/config.json installPath proxy, then the JetBrains plugin bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: Marker '1' with MOE_PROXY_PATH unset, empty, a directory, relative, or vanished before the call, in both the deregister and the fallback-CLI call shapes: exit 1, stdout empty, the refusal line on stderr without the value, and no repo, global, plugin or inherited-PROXY_PATH decoy ran.

Marker unset: named, then repo, then global (non-Windows), then plugin, then 'moe-proxy not found', in that order; a relative MOE_PROXY_PATH still resolves from the caller's cwd.
Marker '', '0', '01', 'true', ' 1' or '1 ': legacy fallback (the repo decoy runs).

Under marker '1', no proxy other than MOE_PROXY_PATH ever runs, whatever the environment holds (PROXY_PATH included).
